mfaHelp: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator, or a one-time recovery code.
invalidMfa: That authentication code is invalid or expired
ssoFailed: Single sign-on could not be completed
tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts — try again in {seconds} seconds
busyTryAgain: The sign-in service is busy — try again in a moment

reset.requestHelp: Enter your account email and we'll send a reset link if it matches an account.
reset.sent: If that email matches an account, a reset link is on its way. The link works once and expires in 30 minutes.
reset.weakPassword: Password must be at least 10 characters
reset.invalidToken: This reset link is invalid or has expired — request a new one
reset.changed: Your password has been changed. Sign in with it now — all other sessions were signed out.
